about: Banking's own fact kinds. Only what this vertical alone mints: the `close.*` and incident-chain `ops.*` kinds the regulatory episode reuses verbatim are declared once, by retail, and a second declaration here would be refused. The invariants restate what banking's `_checks` already enforces — the registry is the index of those rules, and the episode grammar derives checks from the same strings.

fact_kinds.about: Risk-weighted assets; the books holding at any moment sum to it exactly, and the corrected total supersedes the filed one.
One book's RWA; only the affected book's figure is ever corrected.
CET1 capital, unchanged by the restatement — the error was in RWA.
The stated ratio; `_checks` recomputes the division it states.
What the filing reported, permanently — closing it would erase what the bank believed and when (`as_filed_touched`).
The standard's floor. No period, minted once, reused by every later quarter — a duplicate is what `contested_at_equal_authority` catches.
How much the filed RWA understated the truth.
The ratio movement of the correction, in bps.
The contested treatment: working paper and review coexist at different authority; the confirmed statement supersedes only the working one.
The lodgement due date.
The CFO's approval over the open challenge.
When the return was lodged.
filed, then restated — the restated status supersedes the filed one.
Whether the error forces a restatement.
Which book the error sat in.
Why the figures moved.
The second line's on-the-record challenge.
open, then upheld — the ruling supersedes the open status.
The material-error notification to the regulator.
A daily observation in a gapless supersession chain; each quarter's chain starts fresh (`liquidity_cadence_gap` walks the chains).
The daily path's flag against the collateral register.
Who owns the revaluation schedule — 'unassigned' is the control failure.
Customer deposit balances at quarter end. Branches sum to their division and divisions to the group, exactly; a division with no branch network states none.
fact_kinds.note: The branch network. Every one of these decomposes group → division → branch by largest remainder, so `sums-to` is the invariant that matters and check group (h) in banking's `_checks` is what enforces it, refusing as `network_does_not_reconcile`. The kind is its own child kind because the decomposition runs across subjects at one period, exactly as retail's `financial.revenue.actual` does — unlike `capital.rwa_total`, whose children are a different kind because a book is not a smaller bank.

fact_kinds.about: Lending balances at quarter end, derived from the quarter's filed RWA at an average risk weight so the book and the capital held against it are one number seen twice.
New lending settled during the quarter — the flow beside the balance, allocated on the same lending weights.
The quarter's net operating income by division and branch. Every division states one, including those with no estate.
Front-line headcount. The one measure a site that trades nothing still carries — an operations centre holds work, not income.
Lending over deposits, derived from the rounded amounts it describes. A rate: it is stated at group and division and never summed, because a group ratio is not the total of three.
What finance, treasury, risk and the data platform cost, by the cost centre that incurs it. The centres sum to the group figure.
The same total carried by the divisions it is recharged to — a second decomposition of one number across a different set of entities, which is what makes either of them checkable.
